product.name: Monoprice Choice Series NL4FC Speaker Cable with Four 12 AWG Conductors 6ft
product.description: You can rely on Monoprice as the source for your high-performance, high-quality speaker cables with NL4FC connectors!These 4-conductor speaker cables are made with high-purity, 100% pure, bare copper 12 AWG conductors for maximum current handling capability. The 4-conductor design is great for bi-amping only a single cable. The cable features durable nickel female NL4FC connectors at each end, with spring-loaded lock release latches that make these connectors less prone to disconnecting during concerts or just playing your tunes.
